name: Dashing Champion (Marshal Archetype)
body:
These marshals lead by example, not by mentoring and supporting directly, but inspiring through their own exemplary exploits.

Close to Greatness (Ex)

A dashing champion’s aura and inspire action abilities have a reduced range of only 15 feet. However their auras grow in influence at a faster rate. A dashing champion’s aura bonus begins at +2 and increases by +1 at 3rd level and every three levels to a maximum of +7 at 18th level.

This ability modifies auras, the aura bonus, and inspire action class features.

Critical Inspiration (Ex)

At 2nd level, whenever a dashing champion scores a critical hit with a melee weapon, a nearby ally is motivated to do their best. Once per round, after confirming a critical hit, the dashing champion may use inspire action as a swift action to grant a move action to an ally. This use of inspire action is not affected by the dual action ability.

This ability replaces vital inspiration.

Deeds (Ex)

At 4th level, a dashing champion gains a number of exploits called deeds which can be activated by expending uses of inspire action. They gain the deeds listed as 1st level deeds for the swashbuckler. At 12th level they gain the deeds listed as 3rd and 7th level deeds. At 20th level they gain the deeds listed as 11th level deeds.

In addition, a dashing champion can regain a use of inspire action a number of times per day equal to their Charisma modifier by confirming a critical hit against a creature with equal or greater hit dice to the dashing champion.

This ability replaces tactician, greater tactician, and master tactician.

Bleeding Edge (Ex)

At 5th level, a dashing champion can use inspire action as a standard action to grant an ally within 15 feet an attack action, at their highest base attack bonus, against a creature the dashing champion and the chosen ally both threaten. When the dashing champion gains the ability to target two creatures with inspire action they may use this option for either a move action or this attack action.

This replaces the charge option for inspire action normally gained at 5th level and modifies the ability to target two creatures normally gained at 10th level.

Combat Leader (Ex)

At 8th level, a dashing champion is often the first to join the fray. In the first round of combat, if the dashing champion charges an enemy and deals damage, all allies who attack that same creature before the end of the round deal additional weapon damage equal to the dashing champion’s Charisma modifier (minimum +1). At 16th level each ally who attacks that creature before the end of the round treats it as flat-footed.

This ability replaces the bonus teamwork feat normally gained at 8th and 16th level.
